Trusted places to buy luxury fragrance online (U.S.):

### 1) Major authorized beauty retailers
- **Sephora (online)** – large luxury/designer selection and a dedicated luxury-fragrance shop section. ([sephora.com](https://www.sephora.com/shop/luxury-fragrance?utm_source=openai))  
- **Nordstrom (online)** – luxury beauty/fragrance with strong brand partnerships (e.g., CHANEL via Nordstrom as an authorized retailer). ([nordstrom.com](https://www.nordstrom.com/brands/chanel--3503?utm_source=openai))  

### 2) Luxury department stores (reliable supply chain, strong customer service)
- **Bloomingdale’s (online fragrance shop)** – wide range including many luxury and niche brands. ([bloomingdales.com](https://www.bloomingdales.com/shop/makeup-perfume-beauty/fragrance?id=14716&utm_source=openai))  
- **Saks Fifth Avenue / Neiman Marcus** – commonly listed by brands as authorized prestige department-store partners (good choices for luxury fragrance). ([giorgioarmanibeauty-usa.com](https://www.giorgioarmanibeauty-usa.com/authorized-retailers/customer-service-armani-stores.html?utm_source=openai))  

### 3) Brand websites (most “bulletproof” for authenticity)
- Buying **direct from the fragrance house** (CHANEL, Dior, Tom Ford, etc.) is usually the safest option if the brand ships to you.

---

## Quick safety checklist (to avoid counterfeits/grey market)
- Look for wording like **“authorized retailer”** (many brands publish authorized-retailer lists). ([giorgioarmanibeauty-usa.com](https://www.giorgioarmanibeauty-usa.com/authorized-retailers/customer-service-armani-stores.html?utm_source=openai))  
- Be cautious with **too-good-to-be-true pricing**, missing batch codes, or “tester/no box” listings.
- Prefer retailers with easy returns and clear seller identity (avoid unknown third‑party marketplace sellers).

If you tell me **which fragrance/brand** (and your budget), I can suggest the best retailer(s) among these for that specific scent and any legit ways to sample first.
